svg.title: Develop and test on separate examples
svg.desc: Two interview excerpts carry human labels for unmet need. Split all material by participant or document into development and held-out test sets, with a separate training set only if fine-tuning. Develop the rubric, prompt, LLM and settings using development material, then fix the chosen method. Test material bypasses development and is evaluated only afterward. Withhold its human labels from the LLM, then compare its predictions with those labels.

svg.text: Keep choices fixed for the test
Give the LLM test excerpts without their human labels.
